# Step 6: Persist Evidence（Spectra 整合）

完成診斷和計劃輸出後，若偵測到 active Spectra change（Step 0.5）：

1. **寫入 `design-review.md`** 到 change 目錄（`openspec/changes/<name>/design-review.md`）：

```markdown
# Design Review: <change-name>

- **Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Mode**: new / improve / iterate
- **Spectra Change**: <change-name>
- **Target**: [diagnosed pages/components]

## Diagnosis Summary

| Dimension     | Score | Finding |
| ------------- | ----- | ------- |
| Visual        | ★★★☆☆ | ...     |
| Interaction   | ★★★☆☆ | ...     |
| Structure     | ★★★☆☆ | ...     |
| Copy          | ★★★☆☆ | ...     |
| Resilience    | ★★★☆☆ | ...     |
| Performance   | ★★★☆☆ | ...     |
| Accessibility | ★★★☆☆ | ...     |
| Consistency   | ★★★☆☆ | ...     |

## Design Fidelity Report

Source: PRODUCT.md + DESIGN.md
Register: brand | product

| 維度                      | 狀態                   | 證據       |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------- | ---------- |
| Color Tokens              | PASS / DRIFT / MISSING | [具體發現] |
| Typography                | PASS / DRIFT / MISSING | [具體發現] |
| Spacing                   | PASS / DRIFT / MISSING | [具體發現] |

Fidelity Score: N/8 PASS

### DRIFT 修復記錄

- [修復前] → [修復後] — [檔案]

## Copy Tone Check

依 `references/copy-tone.md` 規則檢驗 target 內所有 user-facing string：

| 檢查項                                    | 狀態        | 證據 / 修正記錄 |
| ----------------------------------------- | ----------- | --------------- |
| 無 HTTP / auth engineering jargon         | PASS / FAIL | [具體發現]      |
| 無 DB / system internals 文字露出         | PASS / FAIL | [具體發現]      |
| 無 dev concepts (Payload / UUID / Hash 等) | PASS / FAIL | [具體發現]      |
| 縮寫對目標使用者已展開或屬常識             | PASS / FAIL | [具體發現]      |
| 無中英混用工程詞                          | PASS / FAIL | [具體發現]      |
| 保留的英文屬 PRODUCT.md Users 行業共識    | PASS / FAIL | [具體發現]      |

Copy Tone Score: N/6 PASS

**Exception 申請**（如有）：

- 詞: `<英文詞>` / 位置: `<檔案>` / 理由: `<引 PRODUCT.md Users 佐證>`

## Planned Skills

0. **修復所有 DRIFT 項目**（來自 Design Fidelity Report）
1. **`/impeccable clarify [target]`** — Copy Tone fixes（若 Copy Tone Score < 6/6 則必排）
2. /skill [target] — rationale
3. /skill [target] — rationale
   ...

## Design Decisions

- [記錄影響 spec 的設計決策，便於 spectra-ingest 回饋]
```

2. 此檔案是 `pre-archive-design-gate.sh` hook 的主要檢查依據
